title.narrative: EOSG-Empowering Multilateral Action to deliver on thePact for the Future-2025-2028

description.narrative:
Impact: The Pact for the Future sets a bold vision for a more inclusive and responsive multilateral system. This project turns that vision into action, boosting institutional readiness, adapting the existing peace and security tools to respond to new and emerging threats, and embedding human rights and the rule of law at the heart of UN efforts. By driving system-wide coordination, data-driven and human rights-based decision-making, informed by greater use of anticipatory planning and strategic foresight, it enhances the UN’s agility, coherence, and impact, equipping the system to meet today’s challenges and anticipate tomorrow’s, including within the framework of the UN80 initiative.
Outcomes:
1: Strengthen institutional readiness to further implement the Pact for the Future, including at the country and regional levels, through enhanced advisory capacity, strategic system-wide coordination, and targeted high-level engagement by the Secretary-General. This work supports governance reforms, advances UN 2.0 priorities, ensures system-wide implementation of the Secretary-General’s Call to Action for Human Rights, and builds sustained momentum and accountability toward the Pact for the Future implementation review at the UNGA’s 83rd Session in 2028.
2: Strengthen EOSG capacity to drive the implementation of the Pact for the Future, with a particular focus on its international peace and security pillar, including in relation to the Pact-mandated review on the future of all forms of peace operations, the strengthening of the use of the Secretary-General’s good offices, and the enhancement of data-driven prevention work, while ensuring that related peace and security efforts integrate human rights at all levels.
3: Strengthen the UN80 initiative as a multi-phase, system-wide reform effort to align the UN with today’s and tomorrow’s challenges by enhancing institutional agility and coordination, while fostering inclusive Member State engagement,...
